question.problem: If $[a]_{n}$ denotes the residue class containing all integers congruent to $a$ modulo $n,$ then $[17]_{9}=$
question.worked_solution:
We have $[a]_{9}=[b]_{9}$ if 

$$
a≡b\,(\text{mod}\,9).
$$

The residue class $[17]_{9}$ consists of the elements that are congruent to $17$ modulo $9.$ 

We can find an alternative representation for this residue class as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}[17]_{9} & =\{x\in Z\,|\,x≡17\,(\text{mod}\,9)\} \\  & =\{x\in Z\,|\,x≡1\cdot 9+8\,(\text{mod}\,9)\} \\  & =\{x\in Z\,|\,x≡1\cdot 0+8\,(\text{mod}\,9)\} \\  & =\{x\in Z\,|\,x≡8\,(\text{mod}\,9)\} \\  & =[8]_{9}\end{aligned}
$$
